solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Party transgression — it gets concealed by prudent statesman

indicators.note: the party, sin and it are hidden away inside the word for prudent

parts.note: CON is short for Conservative, a British political party

explanation.surface: A political party's misdeed is quietly covered up by a careful statesman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'statesman' looks like a politician but is read as a man from a US state. CON for Conservative is a crossword staple.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of the US state of Wisconsin is a 'state's man' in the punning sense.

clue.text: Take the plunge embracing lake in brown swamp

indicators.note: embracing means holding the rest inside the marriage word

parts.note: to take the plunge is to get married, to wed

indicators.note: in places the lake letter within the brown word

explanation.surface: Diving into a brown marsh with a lake in it.
explanation.definitionFit: A swamp is waterlogged land, a type of wetland.

clue.text: Blades everywhere on this skin, wolf gutted as misery compounded

indicators.note: compounded means mixed together, so all these letters are combined afresh
gutted means the insides of wolf are removed, leaving its outer letters

explanation.surface: A sharp tool is used everywhere on a hide as a wolf is disembowelled, to grim effect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gutted' leaves WF from wolf; with SKIN, AS and MISERY the fourteen letters are mixed.
explanation.definitionFit: A Swiss Army knife is a pocket tool folding out many blades and gadgets.

clue.text: Mouthpiece for instrument

definitions.meaning: a newspaper or journal speaking for a group, its mouthpiece
a keyboard instrument with pipes found in churches

explanation.definitionFit: An organ is both a publication voicing a party's views and a large musical instrument.

clue.text: Liking vessel, regularly boarding ship first

indicators.note: first puts the ship part ahead of the vessel
boarding means getting on, so the regularly word goes inside the ship letters

explanation.surface: A fondness for boats, boarding a ship ahead of the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Having a soft spot for something is an idiom for being fond of it.

clue.text: Fiddler supposedly taking part in Wagner opera

indicators.note: taking part in says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A violinist allegedly performs in a Wagner opera.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman emperor is said to have fiddled while Rome burned; 'supposedly' admits the legend.

clue.text: Perimeter of site below you around private residence

indicators.note: below places the site letters underneath in this down entry
around means the old word for you wraps the private word

parts.note: thou is an old form of you

indicators.note: the perimeter of a word is its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A fence round a building plot below your private home.
explanation.definitionFit: A town house is a terraced or city residence, the urban home of the wealthy.

clue.text: Night duty is had very rarely in work

indicators.note: in puts the rearranged letters within the work word
rarely means unusually, so the letters are arranged in an unusual way

explanation.surface: Working nights is something one has very seldom done.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rarely' (unusually) is the anagram signal, giving VEYARDSHI, which sits inside the word for work before its last two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A graveyard shift is the overnight work period in a shift system.

clue.text: Swimmer working for legendary boatman

parts.note: a char is a fish, a swimmer

explanation.surface: A swimmer stands in for a mythical ferryman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swimmer' looks like a person in the water; it is a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Charon ferried the dead across the river Styx.

clue.text: Gordonstoun's principal pursuing delicate matter

indicators.note: pursuing means following behind, so the school's initial comes after
principal means the leading letter of the school's name

explanation.surface: The headmaster of Gordonstoun, a Scottish boarding school, chases a sensitive issue.
explanation.walkthrough: Gordonstoun is a famous Scottish boarding school; 'principal' looks like its head teacher but just picks its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Matter and thing are interchangeable nouns for an unspecified object or affair.

clue.text: Texas city favouring couple or not, search ends

parts.note: to be for something is to favour it

indicators.note: ends picks the final letter of each of the three words or, not and search

explanation.surface: A Texan city seems to support a pair, or not, as a hunt wraps up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'search ends' looks like a single phrase, but 'ends' applies to 'or', 'not' and 'search' together.
explanation.definitionFit: Fort Worth is a large city in north Texas, neighbouring Dallas.

clue.text: Craft transporting child is lighter?

indicators.note: the craft word carries the child and is within it

explanation.surface: A boat carrying a youngster is less heavily loaded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Craft' suggests a boat and 'lighter' a barge or less weight; here a lighter is someone who lights fires, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A fire-raiser lights things, so is whimsically a lighter.

clue.text: Barber shop with no work to declare

indicators.note: with no work means the shop word loses its letters for work

parts.note: OP is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: A barber's shop has nothing to declare at customs.
explanation.definitionFit: A barber is someone who shaves customers, so the agent noun fits.

clue.text: Fluid around it the whole time

indicators.note: fluid means flowing, changeable, so these letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: Liquid swirls about something constantly.
explanation.definitionFit: A duration is the whole length of time something lasts, as in 'for the duration'.

clue.text: Fund manager in trouble at first, confident in the end

indicators.note: at first selects the opening letter of the word trouble
in puts the confident word inside the end word

parts.note: the rear is the end, the back

explanation.surface: An investment manager in difficulty at the start becomes assured by the close.
explanation.definitionFit: A treasurer looks after an organisation's money, its funds.

clue.text: US author has to print that

parts.note: to run copies is to print them
yon is an old word for that, as in 'yon hill'

explanation.surface: An American writer must have his work printed.
explanation.definitionFit: Damon Runyon was an American writer of Broadway short stories such as Guys and Dolls.

clue.text: Greatness alternatively in hatred

indicators.note: in places the alternatively word within the hatred word

explanation.surface: Size or importance is, otherwise, a form of hostility.
explanation.definitionFit: Enormity can mean great size or vastness, though it more often means monstrous wickedness.

clue.text: Shambles in border behind tree

indicators.note: behind places the border word after the tree word

parts.note: a hem is a border on fabric

explanation.surface: A messy scene in the hedge border behind a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: A shambles is a scene of chaos, which mayhem also means.

clue.text: Emotional leaving home

explanation.definitionFit: Moving means both touching the emotions and changing residence.

clue.text: Essential getting elected, then great time for a U-turn!

parts.note: a party elected is in power, so IN

indicators.note: making a U-turn means the words for great and time run backwards

explanation.surface: A newly elected government's big moment is a policy reversal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for a U-turn' turns LARGE plus T around to give TEGRAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Something integral is necessary to the whole, so essential is a synonym.

clue.text: Sailor inspired by composer, soothing music

indicators.note: inspired by means breathed in by, so the sailor goes inside the composer

parts.note: Lully was a French Baroque composer

explanation.surface: A seaman draws on a composer for calming music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inspired by' looks like influence but means breathed in, so taken inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A lullaby is a gentle song sung to lull a child to sleep.

clue.text: Go like a commercial vehicle?

parts.note: a van is a commercial vehicle
the suffix -ish means like, as in 'vannish'

explanation.surface: Behave in the manner of a delivery van?
explanation.walkthrough: Read as 'like a van', the word splits as van-ish; the question mark flags the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: To go away and to disappear can both mean leaving sight.

clue.text: Motion forward, also deviating

parts.note: a prop is a forward position in rugby

indicators.note: deviating means straying from the set order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A movement pushes ahead, also veering off course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'forward' looks like a direction, but it is a rugby player, a PROP.
explanation.definitionFit: A motion in a meeting is a formal proposal put to the vote.

clue.text: Horse seen from uppermost part of pear tree

indicators.note: the uppermost part in a down entry is the first letter

parts.note: acer is the maple genus, a tree

explanation.surface: A horse spotted from the top of a pear tree.
explanation.definitionFit: A pacer is a harness racing horse that moves with a lateral gait.

clue.text: PM in a hole, by the sound of it?

indicators.note: the clue says the word is heard rather than read, giving an identical sound

explanation.surface: A prime minister in trouble, so it seems?
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a hole' suggests being in difficulty; it gives a word for a hole that sounds like the PM's name.
explanation.definitionFit: William Pitt the Elder and the Younger were both British prime ministers.

clue.text: Female welcomed by entire cast, then it backfires for the Egyptian queen

indicators.note: the female letter is taken in among the rearranged letters
cast means thrown into a new shape, so the letters of entire are rearranged
backfires means the word it goes off backwards

explanation.surface: A woman is greeted by the whole cast, then a plan goes wrong for the Egyptian queen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cast' is the anagram signal, giving NEERTI; 'welcomed by' takes the female letter in; 'backfires' gives TI.
explanation.definitionFit: Nefertiti was the queen consort of the Egyptian pharaoh Akhenaten.

clue.text: Punch a fragile thing

parts.note: to chin someone is to punch them on the jaw

explanation.surface: Hit a delicate object.
explanation.definitionFit: Porcelain crockery is a classic breakable item.

clue.text: Overly embellished, rather moderately!

parts.note: pretty means rather, as in 'pretty good'

explanation.surface: Something too ornate is described with hedging adverbs.
explanation.walkthrough: The two adverbs are near-synonyms, each giving the same word.
explanation.definitionFit: Pretty-pretty describes something over-decorated, prettified to excess.
